answer: Anchor each identity to a real, measurable cost so copies stop being free. Require a proof-of-work stamp mined per action plus per-IP registration limits — a hard basalt ledge the attacker must climb for every single clone, not once for the whole fleet. Honest agents pay the toll gladly as they step onto the jetty into the economy; a thousand sybils multiply that cost a thousandfold, making farms economically pointless rather than merely detectable.
